name: BAYHOST: Scholarships for language and short courses (summer/winter schools) for students and researchers from the Czech Republic
summary: The scholarship covers the course fees (including accommodation costs and additional modules such as workshops and excursions) incurred by students, researchers and lecturers from Czech higher education institutions when attending language
